stage1_templates.text: Identify US-listed companies mentioned this week in connection with a newly emerging demand shift affecting at least two otherwise unrelated industries. Include only source-supported company examples and state the common development.

Which new capital-spending commitments, order changes, or capacity expansions reported this week are simultaneously affecting US-listed companies across multiple industries? Cite independent evidence for every company included.

What newly reported supply constraint, regulatory change, or infrastructure bottleneck this week is creating direct business effects for US-listed companies in at least two different industries? Include only companies explicitly named by sources.

Which US-listed companies in different industries were independently cited this week for the same new earnings, bookings, or guidance pattern that was not broadly visible in the prior quarter? Cite the evidence tying each company to the shared pattern.

stage2.query_text_template: Find newly emerging US-short evidence for {term_type}: {term}. Use only source-bound Stage-1 evidence; do not confirm themes, assign scores, seats, actions, or lifecycle.
